ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central surface (estimated 85%) with low-intensity black pigmentation (estimated 15%) primarily confined to the trailing edges and median notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the central lobes; black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge with irregular mottled diffusion into the white field; a dark vertical cluster is located at the peduncle base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees; notch depth represents roughly 20% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; significant irregular pixel-amplitude spikes (jagged protrusions) located at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature transitioning from the median notch toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters at the far distal tips of both lobes; scattered dark micro-spots located along the boundary of the white-to-black pigmentation gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, irregular structural protrusions on the distal tips of both lobes consistent with barnacle encrustation/colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated dark pigmentation streak extends vertically from the base of the median notch into the lower central white field.
